Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the "Updated Understanding" section. Upon seeing the search result which explicitly states the chapel is of the "Royal Australian Navy" (RAN), the Planner incorrectly inferred that it must be the "Royal Navy" (the British branch). The Planner confused the name "Royal Australian Navy" with the "Royal Navy," leading to the wrong conclusion that the defense force is the British Armed Forces instead of the Australian Defence Force. This was a hallucination of the relationship between the two navies based on the shared word "Royal," despite the search results clearly identifying the location as Sydney, Australia.
